text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф has crowned herself the

undisputed Emperor of the Twinkle
Series.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Together, we've successfully navigated
the crucial
first three years of her career.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But now the seasons turn, and a new
wind blows
through the grounds of
Tracen Academy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I don't believe it... My first day, and I've
gotten
lost!
text_block_list.name: New Student

text_block_list.text: Who made this place so big?! Argh, what do I do now?
text_block_list.name: New Student

text_block_list.text:
If you are in need of assistance, I would
be glad
to help.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Thank you... Wait, what?! It can't be...
Y-you're...
President Симболи Рудольф!
text_block_list.name: New Student

text_block_list.text: Oh? You've heard of me?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
O-of course I have! Watching you race
was what
inspired me to apply here!
text_block_list.name: New Student

text_block_list.text:
Haha... Was it now? I can imagine no
greater
praise.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Well, know that if you need help finding
your
way, you couldn't have
encountered anyone more
qualified.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I would be more than happy to lend my

assistance.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Really? A-are you sure?!
text_block_list.name: New Student

text_block_list.text:
Of course. And let me take this
opportunity to
say...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Welcome to Академия Тайсен.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
We've been waiting for you. Together
we will
chase our dreams until the day
they are in our
grasps.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
All you could ever need is here. Grow
strong,
leave your mark, and someday...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Someday, you'll appear before my
throne. And I'll
be waiting.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I've come to the student council office at
the time
Симболи Рудольф asked me to,
but she doesn't
seem to be here yet.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're here! I'm sorry I kept you
waiting.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: It's not like you to be late.

text_block_list.text:
I ran into a lost student on the way here
and took
some time to show her around.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I was rather struck by her, I admit. She
was
absolutely brimming with hope.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
As for whether she can hold on to that
hope in
the years to come... only she can
decide.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
In the world of racing, the strong rise to
the top
and the rest quickly fall by the
wayside.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But be that as it may, I want to believe
that the
light within every Umamusume
will win out against
despair.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Everyone deserves to gaze upon the
clear blue
sky.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: So I will continue my march as Emperor.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I will forge the path to a world where
every
Umamusume may live in bliss, and
none shall be
left behind.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Do you think I can do it?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Hah.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. Your uplifting words
never
fail to—
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Oh my.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Your uplifting words never fail to raise my spirits... What a marvelous bit of punnery I've stumbled upon!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
...Ahem. You look profoundly
unimpressed.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Clearly, my wordplay still requires some
work. But
never fear, I shall bring a smile
to your face yet.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Now, come. My dream remains distant,
and my
duties are still pressing.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
We will have little time to rest in the
months and
years to come.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: That does not intimidate you, I trust?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Then we shall forge ahead together.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Let us blaze a trail that all may follow,
and yet
none may catch.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Upon the highest of heights, our glory
awaits!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
